data.name: Narayanaa
data.gender_notes: Narayanaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The ultimate shelter, resting place, and abode of all living entities. The name Narayanaa carries the meaning “Supreme Refuge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Narayanaa usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme refuge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine source and protector of the universe.
data.etymology: Narayanaa belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme Refuge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narayanaa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Narayanaa" is revered in Hindu culture and is believed to represent the ultimate form of God, Vishnu, in his cosmic role as the supreme being and preserver of the universe. This name holds immense importance in Hindu mythology, philosophical texts, and day-to-day devotional practices.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Narayanaa" is the endless source of peace, love, and compassion, who provides solace, protection, and stability to all beings. It is also the supreme purifier, who frees one from the cycle of birth and death, ultimately leading to the ultimate goal of spiritual growth and enlightenment. In simple terms, "Narayanaa" is the eternal refuge and ultimate savior for the distressed and the cherished deity for the devout.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Narayanaa is a divine name signifying the eternal presence of God as the supreme protector, the unchanging cosmic order, and the ultimate refuge in times of distress. It embodies the essence of love, compassion, and preservation, guiding souls towards their spiritual growth and salvation.
